title: Atmos Ascent vs. Summit: Which Alaska Card Fits Your Trips?
caption:
Summit needs to earn its extra $300 a year—in trips you actually take.

Ascent ($95 annually) fits paid companion trips: its anniversary fare is $99 plus taxes and fees from $23, after $6,000 in purchases during the prior anniversary year.

Summit ($395 annually) fits award trips together: its anniversary certificate takes up to 25,000 points off a companion award. You still need available award seats for both travelers, enough points for the remaining cost, and taxes and fees paid with Summit.

The catch: compare Summit against the Ascent benefits you’d give up. More perks on paper don’t cover $300.

For Ascent, compare full trip costs with cheaper alternatives: practicalrewards.com/calculators/alaska-companion-fare.html. That calculator isn’t for Summit certificates.
